O.outcome_detail: presence of time-demand-and-value competency in university frameworks

cells.quote: "Only three of the ten university frameworks evidenced this competency, highlighting an area for further development related to the need to balance the demands that come with embedding digital education practices."
cells.note: The quoted sentence is supplied in the wiki entry; the provided study-text excerpt is truncated before this result. The study reports document presence/counts rather than an instructional treatment effect.
